comparison.objective: Turn a cake out of its pan onto a plate and remove the pan.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp a broad plate-pan stack from opposite sides, lift and rotate it cooperatively, then separate the pan.
comparison.success_condition: The inverted cake rests centred on the plate and stand with the pan removed and the assembly still.
comparison.reason: Two-arm load sharing and flipping are materially different from seating two tools on coupled screw-and-nut hardware and preserving a calibrated setting.
